title: Verify: Runtime systems unit tests
summary: Unit tests for conditions, inventory, events, dialogue and scene engine
description: Write Vitest tests for each runtime system from the requirement spec, using in-memory state only.
acceptance_criteria: Given the tests, when run, then every system has passing cases for success and no-op paths.
Given each test, when it passes a frozen state, then immutability is asserted.

steps.action: Add tests 'evaluateCondition flag true/false' and 'addItem does not duplicate' using a hand-built GameState literal (currentScene 'bedroom', empty collections); assert true/false results and inventory length 1 after adding 'key' twice.
steps.command: cd backend/game && npx vitest run tests/systems.test.ts -t 'condition|addItem'

steps.action: Add tests 'performAction applies set_flag add_item goto_scene' (inputs: an inline SceneDef with one object whose search action has those three events; assert flags.x true, inventory ['key'], currentScene changed, original state deep-equal to a Object.freeze'd copy) and 'performAction no-op when condition fails' (assert returned state toBe input).
steps.command: cd backend/game && npx vitest run tests/systems.test.ts -t 'performAction'

steps.action: Add test 'chooseOption applies events and advances' with a two-node SceneDef: choosing index 0 sets flag, activeDialogue becomes 'n2', history contains the choice text; and 'chooseOption invalid index returns same state'.
steps.command: cd backend/game && npx vitest run tests/systems.test.ts -t 'chooseOption'
